name: jyu_gooface
desc: Keep the same melted, dripping paint body, size and pose. The head is pushing out of the goo: the squarish bear face with the thick angular eyebrows and small eyes, the grumpy mouth peeling open with thick sticky paint strings between the lips, heavy paint dripping from the lips and chin, the small round ears half formed, still half melted, with thick sticky paint stretching and stringing from the face, the chin and the mouth, gooey and gross. The legs stay a thick melted mass merged into the puddle. Same colors, cream swirls, outline and pixel art style.
